title: Tuesday 09:00 UTC run settles Mon 2 Nov to Mon 9 Nov
A run at Tue 08:59:59 UTC settles the week before
Happy path: 10 credits per completed task, one notification per account
Cut-off: Monday 00:00 start included, next Monday 00:00 excluded
+05:00 timestamps are converted to UTC before the window check
Tasks that are not completed earn nothing and trigger no notification
The same task ID twice in one export is paid once
Re-running the job for the same week pays nothing new
A retry after a partial ledger failure pays only the failed task
A task paid last week and re-sent next week is not paid again
A notification failure is reported and does not reverse the payout
No notification when the account's only payout failed
After a failed notification, re-runs deliver it once and pay nothing extra
